description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the user module, including help text, permission management, user role handling, and UI modifications.

classes.name: UserHooks
classes.description: Contains Drupal hook implementations related to user management, permissions, roles, and UI modifications.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help and informational content for various user-related routes.

methods.name: jsSettingsAlter
methods.description: Alters JavaScript settings to include user ID and permissions hash.

methods.name: entityExtraFieldInfo
methods.description: Defines extra fields for user entities, such as account, language, timezone, and member info.

methods.name: userView
methods.description: Adds 'Member for' info to user profile views for authenticated users.

methods.name: userViewAlter
methods.description: Adds default alt tags to user pictures for accessibility.

methods.name: templatePreprocessDefaultVariablesAlter
methods.description: Prepares template variables for user login/logout, removing sensitive info.

methods.name: userLogin
methods.description: Handles actions upon user login, such as theme reset and timezone warnings.

methods.name: userLogout
methods.description: Handles actions upon user logout, such as theme reset.

methods.name: mail
methods.description: Customizes email messages for user-related notifications.

methods.name: userRoleInsert
methods.description: Creates default actions for adding/removing roles when a new role is created.

methods.name: userRoleDelete
methods.description: Removes role-related actions and references when a role is deleted.

methods.name: elementInfoAlter
methods.description: Adds custom processing to password confirmation elements.

methods.name: modulesUninstalled
methods.description: Cleans up user data when modules are uninstalled.

methods.name: toolbar
methods.description: Builds user account toolbar menu with login/logout links.

methods.name: formSystemRegionalSettingsAlter
methods.description: Modifies regional settings form to include user timezone options.

methods.name: filterFormatDisable
methods.description: Removes permissions from roles when a filter format is disabled.

methods.name: entityOperation
methods.description: Provides a link to manage permissions for entity types if available.
